rules.rule:
Warm Path Engine discipline (NormanAI-sales-nav):
1) Notion SoR is the CRMx cockpit database only — refuse legacy crm-core DB ids; do not invent alternate DBs.
2) Write allowlist only: Workplace POC, Connectivity, Angles, People Moves, Warm Path Checked At, Need Warm Path Sync (and optional page-body Warm Paths section). Flag any PATCH/update that writes outside this allowlist.
3) Never write Status, any Fit* property (Fit Score, Fit Raw, Fit: …), or JD human fields (Relationship Notes, Current Angle, Last Touched, Re-check).
4) Attended Sales Navigator only: real Chrome session, pace/jitter from config/pace.json, enforce dailyCompanyCap; reject overnight freestyle / unattended SN automation.
5) Unknown ≠ 0: failed or thin scans must write nothing and must not erase prior paths or coerce missing Fit to 0.
6) Drafts/angles only — never send outbound email or messages from this repo.
